item.text: I found the regression’s exact cause in the earlier authoritative acceptance: `.field, 42, $value` must be rejected at compile time because `$value` is unbound. The parser currently accepts any binding and defers the error to runtime (exit 5). I’ll restore the static-error boundary by rejecting unbound bindings during parsing, while keeping bindings introduced by `as` available to the body.
